mcqs.learning_point: Use the area formula for a parallelogram
mcqs.question: A parallelogram has a base of 8 cm and a perpendicular height of 5 cm. Which of the following expressions correctly gives its area?
mcqs.explanation: The area of a parallelogram is base multiplied by the perpendicular height (A = b \u00d7 h). Here b = 8 cm and h = 5 cm, so A = 8 \u00d7 5 = 40 cm². Option B uses the slant side length (7 cm) instead of height, option C multiplies height with the slant side, and option D adds the lengths, all of which are incorrect.

mcqs.learning_point: Distinguish perpendicular height from slant side
mcqs.question: In parallelogram ABCD, AB = 10 cm (base) and AD = 6 cm. The angle \u03b1 between AB and AD is 60\u00b0. What is the length of the perpendicular height corresponding to base AB?
mcqs.explanation: The height h is the component of side AD perpendicular to AB: h = AD \u00d7 sin \u03b1 = 6 \u00d7 sin 60\u00b0 = 6 \u00d7 (\u221a3/2) = 3\u221a3 \approx 5.20 cm. Option A is the slant side length, not the height. Options C and D are unrelated to the geometry of the figure.

mcqs.question: Parallelogram P has base 12 cm and height 7 cm. Parallelogram Q has base 9 cm, side length 10 cm and the angle between the base and that side is 45\u00b0. Which parallelogram has the larger area?

options.D: Cannot be determined without more information

mcqs.explanation: Area of P = 12 \u00d7 7 = 84 cm². For Q, height = 10 \u00d7 sin 45\u00b0 = 10 \u00d7 (\u221a2/2) = 5\u221a2 \approx 7.07 cm. Area of Q = 9 \u00d7 5\u221a2 \approx 63.6 cm². Hence P has the larger area. Options B and C are incorrect based on the calculations, and D is unnecessary because we have enough data.

mcqs.learning_point: Apply area concepts to composite situations
mcqs.question: A figure consists of a rectangle 15 cm long and 8 cm wide with a parallelogram of base 15 cm and height 6 cm attached along the rectangle's longer side. What is the total area of the composite figure?
mcqs.explanation: Area of rectangle = length \u00d7 width = 15 \u00d7 8 = 120 cm². Area of parallelogram = base \u00d7 height = 15 \u00d7 6 = 90 cm². Total area = 120 + 90 = 210 cm². Options B, C, and D result from incorrect addition or omission of one of the shapes.
